label: Updated 8 AM ET
title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today’s biggest golf stories.

items.headline: DeChambeau and Rahm Leverage Absences
items.text: Bryson DeChambeau and Jon Rahm gained leverage as the PGA Tour's Charles Schwab Challenge at Colonial lacks star players like Scottie Scheffler and Rory McIlroy; DeChambeau is considering playing majors only and doing YouTube full-time amid PGA Tour return talks.

items.headline: Soo Bin Joo Leads ShopRite LPGA
items.text: Soo Bin Joo shot a 3-under 68 in tough coastal winds, two-putted birdie on 18, and stretched her ShopRite LPGA lead to four strokes at 8-under 134 with just one bogey and 25 putts after two rounds.

items.headline: Ex-LIV Winner Targets PGA Tour
items.text: Former LIV Golf leader Eugenio Chacarra left LIV because winning there didn’t qualify for majors or Ryder Cup and lost motivation; he now aims to be the world’s best by improving mental game and wedge control at PGA Tour level.
